stem: What do the descriptions of the future throughout the poem suggest about the speaker?

options.label: F
options.text: He believes that people will be intimidated by the challenge of space travel.

options.label: G
options.text: He feels confident that people will be able to travel easily through space.

options.label: H
options.text: He assumes that living on another planet will be different from living on Earth.

options.label: J
options.text: He accepts that space travel likely will be unavailable during his lifetime.
